relay.intro: Short word problems, one after the other. The answer to each is a whole number from 0 to 9999.
relay.points: Points: a problem is worth {{min}} to {{max}} points, {{total}} in total. Each wrong guess lowers the points a problem is worth by 1.

relay.noReturn: You cannot return to an earlier problem later.

strategy.intro: A two-player strategy game against the computer. You can read its rules once you start. You get points if you manage to beat the computer twice in a row in live games.
strategy.live: Points: you get {{max}} points if you beat the computer twice in a row in live games with no loss. Live losses lower it to {{next}}, then {{rest}}.
strategy.noAbandon: A game, once started, has to be played to the end.
strategy.practice: Practice game: does not count towards your score.
strategy.practiceHint: Try out how the game goes, and check that you understand the rules. The computer may not play its best here. You can play practice games at any time, between live games too.
strategy.time: You have {{minutes}} minutes: the clock starts when you click “Start”. Practice games count towards the time too.

disclaimer.interfaceDescription: The interface can be filled in using your PCs or phones as well. You can even log in from multiple devices.
disclaimer.interfaceDescriptionOfflineMode:
The interface can be filled in on both mobile and computer. Please make sure to complete the online round from at most 1 device, and also do not refresh the page during the competition.
(If you nevertheless refresh the page, the competition will restart (but your results so far will be kept). In that case, go back as quickly as possible to the task where you left off. Note that although the timer restarts after refreshing, we will still only take into account answers that arrive within the official time limit.)
disclaimer.progressDescription: Teams that earn at least {{minpoints}} points out of the maximum {{maxpoints}} points that can be earned will proceed to the next round. (We reserve the right to lower this minimum threshold, but we will not raise it.)
disclaimer.progressDescriptionOnline: Teams that earn at least {{minpoints}} points out of the maximum {{maxpoints}} points that can be earned will proceed to the regional round. (We reserve the right to lower this minimum threshold, but we will not raise it.) The points earned in the online round do not count towards the later results.
disclaimer.start: In the competition, teams must work on their own; they must not ask for help from other people until the competition ends{{until}}. The use of artificial intelligence is also forbidden.
disclaimer.startOnline: In the online round, teams must work on their own; they must not ask for help from other people until the competition ends{{until}}. The use of artificial intelligence is also forbidden.
